title: Employment Situation (Jul 2027 data) — 08:30 ET, the first payroll AFTER the 2027-07-28 FOMC
source: EST: derived from BLS's own published scheduling rule — the Employment Situation is released on the third Friday following the end of the reference week (the Sun-Sat week containing the 12th) — using the implementation this proposer re-wrote and re-validated from scratch on 2026-09-09, 7 for 7 against the four confirmed jobs-* entries on this calendar (2026-09-04, 2026-10-02, 2026-11-06, 2026-12-04) and the three historical Sunday-July-4 releases (2004-07-02, 2010-07-02, 2021-07-02). For July 2027 the reference week is Sun 2027-07-11 to Sat 2027-07-17, and the third Friday after 07-17 is 2027-08-06. The prefix is EST: and not BLS: because bls.gov returned HTTP 403 on all four schedule routes tried on 2026-09-09 and fred.stlouisfed.org failed to connect — recorded in jobs-2027-07-02's probe-ref.blocked. A derived date is not a published one
notes: PROPOSED BY jobs-2027-07-02's initial research (2026-09-09) at D+35 — outside the 5-day corridor, and proposed anyway because it is the fact that makes the proposer's own quarter call checkable: with this print on 2027-08-06 and the FOMC on 2027-07-28, jobs-2027-07-02 is the LAST payroll before that meeting and no other payroll prints in between. WHY IT IS SAFE TO DERIVE HERE: the rule's one documented failure mode is a holiday landing on the rule's own Friday (in Saturday-July-4 years the rule outputs the observed-holiday Friday and BLS shifts the release earlier — 2026-07-03 is the live example). 2027-08-06 is an ordinary Friday with no holiday within a week of it, so the rule applies unconditionally. HONEST LIMITS. (1) STATUS IS ESTIMATE AND MUST STAY THERE until bls.gov's 2027 schedule is actually retrieved; a web search on 2026-09-09 corroborates that BLS has not yet published one. Promotion trigger: any successful fetch of the BLS 2027 release schedule naming this date, which flips the prefix to BLS: and the status to confirmed. (2) It is the FIRST of the two payrolls the 2027-09-15 FOMC will see, not an input to 2027-07-28. (3) impact high and symbols [] match every other jobs-* entry on this calendar. Estimates widen caution and license no entry.
